# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Extrae el texto visible de secciones/bloques (por id) del HTML final, en orden, para revisión humana o por agentes.
Marcas: ⟶NOTA (lectNota), ▶VIDEO (vidBox), 🧭RUTA, ▸/◂ plegables, [SVG …] con sus rótulos, [IMG alt], [PIE] pies de figura."""
import sys, re
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup, NavigableString, Tag

BLOCKS = {'p','li','h1','h2','h3','h4','h5','h6','summary','figcaption','div','section','ul','ol','table','tr','td','th',
          'figure','details','blockquote','pre','dl','dt','dd','article','aside','header','footer','nav','main','br','hr'}
PRE = {'h1':'# ','h2':'## ','h3':'### ','h4':'#### ','h5':'##### ','li':'- ','summary':'▸ ','figcaption':'[PIE] '}

def has_block(el):
    return any(isinstance(d, Tag) and (d.name in BLOCKS or d.name in ('svg','img')) for d in el.descendants)

class X:
    def __init__(s): s.lines=[]; s.buf=[]; s.sec='?'; s.nsvg={}
    def flush(s, prefix=''):
        t=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',''.join(s.buf)).strip(); s.buf=[]
        if t: s.lines.append(prefix+t)
    def run(s, el):
        for ch in el.children:
            if isinstance(ch, NavigableString):
                if type(ch).__name__ in ('Comment','Doctype'): continue
                s.buf.append(str(ch)); continue
            if not isinstance(ch, Tag): continue
            n=ch.name
            if n in ('script','style','noscript','template'): continue
            if n=='svg':
                s.flush(); s.nsvg[s.sec]=s.nsvg.get(s.sec,0)+1; t=ch.find('title'); d=ch.get('aria-label') or ''
                desc=(t.get_text(' ',strip=True) if t else '') or d
                labs=[x.get_text('',strip=True) for x in ch.find_all('text')]; labs=[l for l in labs if l]
                s.lines.append(f"[SVG {s.sec}#{s.nsvg[s.sec]}{': '+desc[:200] if desc else ' SIN DESCRIPCIÓN'}]" + (f" rótulos: {' · '.join(labs)[:1200]}" if labs else ''))
                continue
            if n=='img':
                s.flush(); s.lines.append(f"[IMG alt={ch.get('alt','')[:200]!r}]"); continue
            if n not in BLOCKS:   # inline
                if has_block(ch): s.run(ch)
                else: s.buf.append(ch.get_text(''))
                continue
            s.flush()
            if n=='section' and ch.get('id'): s.sec=ch.get('id')
            cls=' '.join(ch.get('class',[])); idp=f"  {{#{ch.get('id')}}}" if ch.get('id') and n in ('section','div','figure','details','li','h2','h3','h4') else ''
            mark = '⟶NOTA' if 'lectNota' in cls else '▶VIDEO' if 'vidBox' in cls else '🧭RUTA' if 'rutaBox' in cls else ''
            if mark: s.lines.append(f'<<{mark}{idp}>>')
            if n=='details': s.lines.append(f'▸▸ PLEGABLE{idp}')
            if n=='table':
                for tr in ch.find_all('tr'):
                    s.lines.append('| '+' | '.join(re.sub(r'\s+',' ',c.get_text(' ',strip=True)) for c in tr.find_all(['td','th']))+' |')
            elif not has_block(ch):
                t=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',ch.get_text('')).strip()
                if t: s.lines.append(PRE.get(n,'')+t+(idp if n in('h2','h3','h4','li') else ''))
                elif idp and n in ('section','div'): pass
            else:
                if idp and not mark and n!='details' and n in ('section','figure','div') and ch.get('id'): s.lines.append(f'<{n}{idp}>')
                if n in PRE:
                    # bloque con contenido mixto
                    s.buf.append(''); 
                s.run(ch); s.flush(PRE.get(n,''))
            if n=='details': s.lines.append('◂◂ fin plegable')
            if mark: s.lines.append(f'<</{mark}>>')

print('auditOnly quitados',n)
secs=[m for m in re.findall(r'<section class="panel section" id="((?:ap-cap|guia-teoria-)[^"]*)"',s)]
tot=0

print(len(secs),'secciones',tot)
# ejercicios U2 por tramos y las secciones «más ejercicios resueltos» / guía de las otras unidades
